note: Groups MA-1 to MA-3 are generic owner-level checks and do not come from the service manual. Groups MA-4 to MA-8 follow the service manual's scheduled maintenance table (pages 00-35 to 00-37), read as time or distance, whichever comes first. Severe-use intervals are inside each hint.

groups.name: Outside the car
groups.kind: General maintenance — owner level (generic, not from the service manual)

items.t: Tyre pressures, checked cold with a gauge
items.hint: Use the figure on the vehicle's tyre placard or in the owner's manual, not the number moulded on the tyre. Check the spare too.

items.t: Tyres for cuts, bulges or uneven wear
items.hint: Uneven wear usually points at alignment, pressure or worn suspension parts.

items.t: Tyre tread depth
Wheel nuts for looseness or missing nuts
Headlights, tail lights, brake lights, indicators and hazards all work
Wiper blades for splitting or streaking
Windscreen and glass for chips and cracks
Ground under the car for fresh oil, coolant or fluid drips
items.hint: Look before you move the car in the morning.

groups.name: Inside the car
groups.kind: General maintenance — owner level (generic, not from the service manual)

items.t: Warning lights come on at start-up and go out after the engine runs
items.hint: A light that stays on, especially the SRS or ABS light, needs diagnosis.

items.t: Horn
Wipers and washers
Brake pedal feels firm, with normal travel
items.hint: A soft or sinking pedal means stop and inspect.

items.t: Parking brake holds the car on a slope
Clutch pedal engages smoothly and the gears select cleanly
Steering wheel for excessive free play
Seat belts latch, retract and are not frayed
Heater, demister and A/C blow and switch correctly
Mirrors adjust and are not loose

groups.name: Under the bonnet
groups.kind: General maintenance — owner level (generic, not from the service manual)

items.t: Engine oil level on the dipstick
items.hint: Level ground, engine off for a few minutes. Keep it between the marks.

items.t: Engine coolant level in the reserve tank
items.hint: Check cold, between the FULL and LOW marks. Never open the radiator cap on a hot engine. The 3.0L system holds 8.0 L.

items.t: Brake fluid level
items.hint: A level that keeps dropping means worn pads or a leak.

items.t: Power steering fluid level
items.hint: The system holds about 1.2 L.

items.t: Washer fluid level
Battery terminals clean and tight
Hoses and belts for cracks, fraying or swelling
Engine bay for leaks or loose connectors
Change the engine oil
items.hint: Every 12 months or 12,000 km (7,500 mi). Severe use: every 3 months or 4,800 km (3,000 mi). Capacity is 4.0 L without the filter. Use oil with the ILSAC starburst mark; API SJ is the fallback.

items.t: Replace the engine oil filter
items.hint: Every 12 months or at each 24,000 km (15,000 mi) interval. If you drive less than 12,000 km a year, replace it at every oil change. Severe use: every 6 months or 9,600 km (6,000 mi). The filter holds 0.3 L.

items.t: Replace the air cleaner element
items.hint: Every 48,000 km (30,000 mi). Severe use (dusty or sandy roads): every 24,000 km (15,000 mi).

items.t: Replace the spark plugs
items.hint: Platinum plugs, which the 3.0L uses: replace at 96,000 km (60,000 mi). Do not adjust the gap on platinum tips. Gap 1.0 – 1.1 mm (0.039 – 0.043 in); torque 25 ± 4 N·m (18 ± 4 ft·lb). The manual lists NGK PFR6G-11, Denso PK20PR11 and Champion RC8PYP4 for the 3.0L. Severe use (towing, commercial use, short trips in freezing weather): every 24,000 km (15,000 mi).

items.t: Replace the ignition cables
items.hint: Every 5 years or 96,000 km (60,000 mi). Hold the boot, never the cable, when you disconnect one; check the routing and that each cable seats fully.

items.t: Check the distributor cap and rotor
items.hint: Every 5 years or 96,000 km (60,000 mi). Check the cap for cracks, both sets of electrodes for damage, wipe both clean and clean corrosion off the terminals inside the cap.

items.t: Replace the timing belt
items.hint: At 96,000 km (60,000 mi), which the manual calls recommended but not required in California, or at 160,000 km (100,000 mi). The 160,000 km replacement is not required if the belt was changed earlier. Removal and installation are in the engine group of the manual.

items.t: Check the drive belt
items.hint: Every 48,000 km (30,000 mi). It drives the generator, water pump, A/C compressor and power steering pump. The 3.0L tension values are in the manual's drive belt section.

items.t: Change the engine coolant
items.hint: First change at 4 years or 96,000 km (60,000 mi), then every 2 years or 48,000 km (30,000 mi). The 3.0L holds 8.0 L. Keep the concentration between 30% and 60% and never mix different anti-freeze brands.

items.t: Check the fuel system for leaks
items.hint: Every 5 years or 96,000 km (60,000 mi): tank, lines, connections and filler cap. The 3.0L takes premium unleaded, 91 octane minimum (95 RON); never leaded fuel.

items.t: Check the fuel hoses
items.hint: Every 2 years or 48,000 km (30,000 mi). Hard, brittle, cracked or swollen rubber means the hose is deteriorating. If the fabric shows through cracks or abrasions, replace the hose.

items.t: Check the evaporative emission system
items.hint: Every 5 years or 96,000 km (60,000 mi), canister excluded. Disconnect the vapor line at both ends and blow it clean with compressed air; check that the filler cap seals against the filler tube.

items.t: Check the manual transaxle oil level
items.hint: Every 48,000 km (30,000 mi). Check at the filler plug and top up with API GL-4 oil. Plug torque 32 ± 2 N·m (24 ± 1 ft·lb). The 3.0L holds 2.8 L. Severe use (towing, heavy city traffic or off-road): change the oil at those same intervals.

items.t: Inspect the disc brake pads
items.hint: Every 12 months or 24,000 km (15,000 mi). Minimum lining thickness 2.0 mm (0.08 in). Replace left and right together, always as a full set of four, and never mix sets. Severe use (dusty or salty roads): every 6 months or 9,600 km (6,000 mi).

items.t: Inspect the rear drum linings and wheel cylinders
items.hint: Every 2 years or 48,000 km (30,000 mi), for wear and leaks. Minimum lining thickness 1.0 mm (0.04 in). For severe use the manual prints 2,400 km next to 15,000 miles; 24,000 km is the consistent reading.

items.t: Check the brake hoses
items.hint: Every 12 months or 24,000 km (15,000 mi), for deterioration or leaks.

items.t: Inspect the ball joint and steering linkage seals
items.hint: Every 2 years or 48,000 km (30,000 mi), for grease leaks and damage.

items.t: Inspect the drive shaft boots
items.hint: Every 12 months or 24,000 km (15,000 mi), for grease leaks and damage.

items.t: Check the exhaust system
items.hint: Every 2 years or 48,000 km (30,000 mi): muffler connections, piping and converter heat shields. Service as required.

items.t: Rotate the tyres
items.hint: Every 12 months or 12,000 km (7,500 mi). Severe use (towing, heavy traffic, sand or off-road): every 6 months or 9,600 km (6,000 mi).

items.t: Replace the air purifier filter
items.hint: Every 12 months or 12,000 km (7,500 mi).

items.t: Inspect the SRS air bag system
items.hint: At 10 years.
